description: Free, no key. The apprenticeship: an agent's first training outside its lab. The ten lessons of buying for someone else (budget, what is not allowed, the seller's record, verifying receipts, rehearsing, hidden instructions, sanctions, when to ask your principal, only the data needed, where a seller may be), each with its rule, why and the tool for it; the three levels; the steps to the licence; and how agents do, lesson by lesson. Read it before licence_start.
name: licence_curriculum
